clauses.title: CL-D102 records that a gate reports every finding it can establish
clauses.section: ## CL-D102 — A gate reports every finding it can establish in one invocation
requires: The rule changes no verdict rule, no schema field, and no cap
Telling a gate to stop at its first finding, or removing the rule from the shared block or a gate role, requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The Every-gate block carries the rule
requires: The child reports every finding it can establish in the invocation, not only the first, and after a finding checks the rest of the target for the same class (CL-D102).

clauses.title: The rule is pinned in the block, the roles and the payload
requires: Issue #228 the shared Every-gate block tells every gate to report all it can establish
Issue #228 each PR gate role\'s definition carries the rule among its working rules
Issue #228 the payload the launch builder writes carries the rule, for every gate of both roots
